metadata.description: Phase 5 (Community): visual mode editor, mode registry with signing and a verified badge, carrier PCB, translations, build guides, community processes. Refreshed 2026-10-22 after phases 2-4 software (decisions P5R-1 to P5R-14); plan phases 1 (the visual mode editor) and 2 (the editor and the simulator: field.lua shown in the web view, POST /api/reload, the editor's Test button, decisions P5B-1 to P5B-7) built in software; plan phase 13 (missing modes sent to boxes from the GM console, the maintainer's P5R-8; P5B-8 to P5B-17) planned. Plan phases 3 (the editor's geo, GM command, role and kind blocks, screens; P5C-1 to P5C-7), 4 (signed mode packages: canonical ustar archive, Ed25519 manifest, tools/mode_package.py, registry index schema, shared vectors; P5C-8 to P5C-13), 5 (the sandbox-escape battery, which closed two watchdog escapes; P5C-14 to P5C-16) and 6 (signed packages in the controller and console; P5C-17 to P5C-21) built in software; P5B-9 answered by the maintainer (firmware-built mode keys only). Plan phase 13a (missing modes from the GM console: the controller, console and protocol side; join keys 16 and 17, the endpoints boxes fetch from, the start guard, the invite dialog's Send missing modes; P5D-1 to P5D-12) built in software 2026-10-22; 13b (the box fetching, checking and keeping signed mode packages: mode_package.c, mode_fetch.c, mode_store.c, mode_fetch_esp.c, join keys 16 and 17 in core/src/join.c, node.modes_failed; P5E-1 to P5E-14) built in software against 13a's contract. Plan phase 7 (scenario blocks in the GM console: a Blocks view of the Scenarios tab's YAML editor writing the same manifest, read back through the controller's check, Blockly 13.3.0 vendored with a hash-only CSP exception for its two stylesheets, every scenario example compiling identically; P5F-1 to P5F-12) built in software 2026-10-22. Plan phases 8 (the registry repository's template registry/template/ with its CI, tools/registry_check.py, a sample submission tested with throwaway keys; P5G-1 to P5G-11) and 9 (CONTRIBUTING.md 'Submitting a community mode', docs/community/, the draft RFC for the package format; P5G-12 to P5G-14) built in software 2026-10-22; AC-6 met in this repository's template, AC-11 met.
metadata.next_plan_phase: 10 (German), in progress; then the leftovers (the editor making packages, contract cases for the mode-package endpoints); 13 on real boxes in HW3
